title: benchmarkWorkspace
responsibility: Creates pinned regular-file workspaces and overlays only allowed implementation changes.

inputs.name: benchmarkGit.cwd
inputs.description: Working directory in which Git executes with repository hooks disabled.

inputs.name: benchmarkFiles.project
inputs.description: Git repository root supplying committed benchmark source.

inputs.name: benchmarkFiles.revision
inputs.description: Pinned commit whose tracked regular files form the baseline.

inputs.name: snapshotBenchmark.project
inputs.description: Git repository root supplying committed benchmark source.

inputs.name: snapshotBenchmark.revision
inputs.description: Pinned commit whose tracked regular files form the baseline.

inputs.name: snapshotBenchmark.destination
inputs.description: Temporary directory receiving extracted or copied committed files.

inputs.name: createBenchmarkWorkspace.baseline
inputs.description: Pristine extracted source copied into each isolated trial or evaluator.

inputs.name: createBenchmarkWorkspace.destination
inputs.description: Temporary directory receiving extracted or copied committed files.

inputs.name: regularBenchmarkFile.root
inputs.description: Root containing the exact project-relative file to inspect.

inputs.name: regularBenchmarkFile.file
inputs.description: Relative file path checked for regular entries and content identity.

inputs.name: benchmarkFileValue.root
inputs.description: Root containing the exact project-relative file to inspect.

inputs.name: benchmarkFileValue.file
inputs.description: Relative file path checked for regular entries and content identity.

inputs.name: overlayBenchmarkFiles.source
inputs.description: Trial workspace supplying the allowed implementation changes.

inputs.name: overlayBenchmarkFiles.target
inputs.description: Clean evaluator workspace receiving allowed changes.

inputs.name: overlayBenchmarkFiles.files
inputs.description: Exact allowed implementation paths to copy or remove.

outputs.name: benchmarkGit
outputs.description: Captured stdout from a successful Git command.

outputs.name: benchmarkFiles
outputs.description: Regular tracked paths from the pinned revision.

outputs.name: snapshotBenchmark
outputs.description: Tracked paths retained in the extracted committed baseline.

outputs.name: createBenchmarkWorkspace
outputs.description: Resets and initializes a fresh baseline Git workspace.

outputs.name: regularBenchmarkFile
outputs.description: Whether every path segment is nonsymbolic and the final entry is a regular file.

outputs.name: benchmarkFileValue
outputs.description: Executable permission bits and SHA-256 fingerprint, or undefined for a nonregular path.

outputs.name: overlayBenchmarkFiles
outputs.description: Copies or removes only allowed implementation paths in the evaluator.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects Git failures, unsupported symlinks or submodules, and incomplete extraction.
